text:
carol_support: FYI receiving customer ping — multiple 5xx (502/504) and timeouts hitting /v1/generate from hosted inference. Customer says it started ~09:10 UTC and their requests are intermittently failing with 504s. attaching snippet from their request headers/logs.

ben_sre: looking. any recent deploys or routing changes?

alice_ops: we rolled the eu-west routing tweak at 09:05 but that was just edge weights. rolling back now to test.

devin_infra: seeing a flood of backend conn errors from runtime pool in eu-west: "upstream connect error or disconnect" in the gateway logs. k8s HPA looks fine.

incident-bot: ALERT: hosted-inference: spike in gateway 5xx rate (+420% p90) from 09:07-09:18 UTC. linked runbook: https://confluence.redwood/infr/runbooks/hosted-5xx

carol_support: customer provided sample client payloads — small sync reqs, not huge batches. they see 10-20% failure rate. escalating to SRE.

ben_sre: can someone paste kube proxy and gateway pods in that timeframe? run: kubectl -n hosted logs deploy/api-gateway --since-time=2026-03-10T09:00:00Z | sed -n '1,200p'

alice_ops: rollback complete at 09:14 UTC. no more config change events after that.

devin_infra: reproducer: I forwarded a few requests from the customer's IP — we hit a backend instance that returned 502 quickly, then that instance got removed from LB due to health check flapping. looks like a small subset of inference workers had sudden KV cache thrashing and OOM kworker restarts. stack snippet: ```runtime: kv-cache: miss-rate 0.92; oom_kill: process=runtime-worker pid=4123```.

ellen_eng: kv-cache miss + OOM pattern — sounds like recent quantized model variant memory regression? any canaries?

devin_infra: we had a canary yesterday for q4 quantized pack on a subset of hosts in eu-west; scheduler accidentally pushed a wider subset due to label selector mismatch at ~08:50 UTC. rolling that back now.

maria_ce: customer is on a paid Dedicated plan but hitting hosted endpoint — they're very sensitive to this, asking for ETA and mitigation.

carol_support: told customer we're investigating and provided temporary mitigation: change route to fallback model variant (lower mem) and enable 10s client retry with jitter. they asked for status updates every 15m.

ben_sre: short-term mitigation checklist: 1) remove bad runtime nodes from pool (done), 2) route traffic to fallback model variant (carol/maria coordinating), 3) increase gateway per-host connlimit and timeout to avoid amplifying timeouts. I can apply connlimit bump now.

alice_ops: connlimit bumped + keepalive increased to 60s at 09:22 UTC. observing p50/p90 latency improving for ~70% requests.

devin_infra: I pushed rollback of quantized pack at 09:24. autoscaler is rebalancing, new nodes are healthy. OOM events stop from what I can see.

incident-bot: NOTE: deploybot rolled back deploy id=canary-q4-2026-03-09-17:24 at 09:24 UTC by devin_infra.

ellen_eng: next steps for post-incident: - reproduce locally with quant pack and KV config, - run stress tests on small-memory hosts, - add preflight gating for label selectors.

carol_support: customer confirmed errors dropping to <1% after 09:30 UTC, still watching. they appreciated quick fallback routing.

maria_ce: please send a customer summary and CLARIFY what happened + committed mitigations. I'll send with 1 hour SLA.

ben_sre: action items (assign): ai-1 check label selector gating in scheduler (alice_ops), ai-2 add kv-cache OOM alert at runtime level (devin_infra), ai-3 improve canary overlap checks & preflight (ellen_eng), ai-4 draft customer communication and postmortem (carol_support + maria_ce).

alice_ops: taking ai-1. I'll add a guard clause so label selectors require explicit --confirm flag for mass matching.

devin_infra: taking ai-2. will add metric alert: runtime.oom_count > 0 for >1m in a host group -> paged.

ellen_eng: taking ai-3. will add a preflight test to the canary pipeline to validate memory footprint and KV-miss regression against baseline.

carol_support: taking ai-4, will draft and share in #support-updates.

ben_sre: postmortem checklist: timeline, root cause = unintended broad canary due to selector mismatch leading to memory-regressed quant pack on subset of hosts -> KV thrash -> OOM -> gateway 502/504s, mitigations taken, action items. target postmortem doc by EOD tomorrow.

incident-bot: WAR ROOM CLOSED at 10:05 UTC — incident marked mitigated. followups assigned.

carol_support: thanks all. I'll update customer and link postmortem when ready. :thumbsup:

maria_ce: +1. please notify me when postmortem is published so I can attach to the customer case.
